subject: FY25 Community Preservation Act Funding Recommendations
overview: The Committee of the Whole reviewed eight fiscal year 2025 Community Preservation Act funding recommendations totaling over $1.8 million across housing, historic preservation, and recreation projects. The committee voted to refer all recommendations to the regular City Council meeting for formal approval.

items.title: Community Preservation Act funding overview and project presentations
items.summary: CPA Manager Theresa Dupont introduced the FY25 funding round, followed by presentations from applicants including $250,000 for the Affordable Housing Trust, DPW requests for Oak Grove Cemetery and Playstead Park tennis courts, Condon Shell lighting, Council Chamber windows, and assistance programs.

items.title: Referral of Unitarian Universalist Church restoration project
items.summary: Referred the Unitarian Universalist Church exterior restoration proposal to the regular City Council meeting after severing it so two council members could abstain.

items.title: Referral of remaining Community Preservation Act funding recommendations
items.summary: Referred the remaining seven Community Preservation Act funding proposals to the regular City Council meeting.
